logic: What a receipt can print (plan v3 slice 1.9, lead decision after round 1, S-M1 and T-M3): the characters the receipt fonts of every theme carry, so that nothing is issued and frozen that no browser can draw. A text is printed as follows: first every invisible format character is dropped (U+00AD, U+061C, U+180E, U+200B-U+200F, U+202A-U+202E, U+2060-U+2064, U+2066-U+206F, U+FEFF: soft hyphen, zero-width characters, bidi marks and controls, word joiners, the byte order mark), then the rest is composed to Unicode NFC, and the result is the printed text; this is the only way the drawn text may differ from the frozen one. Every code point of the printed text must then lie in the printable set: U+0020-007E, U+00A0-00AC, U+00AE-0148, U+014A-01C3, U+01C5-024F, U+0259, U+02BB-02BC, U+02C6-02C7, U+02DA, U+02DC-02DD, U+0375-0376, U+037A-037F, U+0384-038A, U+038C, U+038E-03A1, U+03A3-03D7, U+03DC-03DD, U+03F0-03F6, U+03F9-03FA, U+03FC-0479, U+0480-0482, U+048A-049D, U+04A0-04FF, U+1E00-1E9B, U+1E9D-1EFB, U+2013-2014, U+2018-201A, U+201C-201E, U+2020, U+2022, U+2026, U+2032-2033, U+2039-203A, U+20AC, U+2116, U+2122, U+2212 (Latin with Latin-1, Extended-A, Extended-B and Extended Additional, so Romanian and Vietnamese too, the schwa, the modifier apostrophes, Greek, Cyrillic, the typographic punctuation, euro, numero, trade mark and minus: every one of them that Inter, regular and bold, and DejaVu Sans, regular and bold, both carry, less the characters NFC never leaves as they are). expected.text is the printed text and expected.outside names each code point of it outside the set once, as U+XXXX (at least four upper-case hex digits), in the order of first appearance; an empty list means the text prints. The backend (shared/domain/PrintableText, runner PrintableTextSharedCasesTest) refuses a name or address with an outside character at registration and profile change, and refuses to issue a receipt whose printed data has one, before a number is taken; the browser (receipt-pdf/receipt-characters.ts, runner receipt-characters.spec.ts) prints the text it gives and refuses to draw a receipt with an outside character, and every receipt font of every theme carries every character of the set (receipt-layout.spec.ts).

cases.name: A Czech name and address print as they are

input.text: Jana Nováková, Dlouhá 12, 400 01 Ústí nad Labem

expected.text: Jana Nováková, Dlouhá 12, 400 01 Ústí nad Labem

cases.name: The first and the last character of every printable range print
The characters next to every printable range, dropped ones aside, are outside the set, each named once in the order they appear
Every invisible format character that drawing drops, first and last of each dropped range, leaves nothing to print
A character that composition maps to another is judged by what it becomes: the Greek question mark and the Kelvin and ohm signs print, the Greek numeral sign does not
A Romanian name with comma below prints

input.text: Ștefan Țurcanu, Strada Mihai Viteazu 7, Iași

expected.text: Ștefan Țurcanu, Strada Mihai Viteazu 7, Iași

cases.name: A zero-width space, bidi marks, a word joiner and a byte order mark in a name are dropped
A soft hyphen is dropped
A format character between a letter and its combining accent is dropped, and the two compose
A combining accent with no composed letter is outside the set
A tab and a line break are outside the set
A Chinese character is outside the set, named once however often it appears
An emoji outside the basic plane is named by its code point
A ligature character is outside the set
An empty text prints as empty
A text of only invisible format characters prints as empty, so it counts as blank
